description: PROCEDURE: Custom domain setup in one step — reads TLS certificate PEM files from disk (e.g. from certbot/Let's Encrypt), creates a TLS secret in Code Engine, then creates the domain mapping. Returns the CNAME target value to add in your DNS provider.

app_name.description: The Code Engine app to map the custom domain to

cert_pem_path.description: Path to the certificate chain PEM file — typically ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/fullchain.pem

key_pem_path.description: Path to the private key PEM file — typically ~/certbot/config/live/<domain>/privkey.pem

project_id_or_name.description: Code Engine project name or ID

tls_secret_name.description: Name to give the TLS secret in Code Engine (e.g. myapp-tls). Must be unique in the project.

name: proc_setup_custom_domain
